source_prompt: A dark, high-tension parody where CharacterA and CharacterB are two desperate friends in a dilapidated, rainy alleyway. They are aggressively fighting and shouting over a pipe—the last of their supply. The atmosphere is grimy and claustrophobic. Both characters show extreme 'tweaking' behavior: CharacterA is twitching and clutching the rock with skeletal fingers, while CharacterB is sweaty, bloated, and looming over him with a threatening stance. The tone is chaotic and 'shady,' using shaky-cam movements and dramatic lighting to emphasize their total desperation.
character_a_brief: yellow square sponge, big blue eyes, buck teeth, white shirt, red tie, brown shorts, anxious energetic expression
character_b_brief: pink starfish, round belly, worried expression, green shorts with purple flowers, holding a wooden pipe
story_type: Gritty Urban Parody, Brainrot Comedy, Shady Skit, High-Stakes Rivalry, Cinematic Drama

script_package.title: Roadman Ruckus: The Last Pipe
script_package.description: Watch these two mandem go absolutely mental over the last pipe! Pure urban brainrot, fam. You won't believe the madness.
script_package.spoken_script:
Character A: "Yo, bruv, that's MY pipe! On my life, I saw it first."
Character B: "Nah, fam, you're moving mad! This ain't yours, I had it in my hand."
Character A: "You washed, fam! Always tryna finesse the last bit. Give it here!"
Character B: "I'll buss your head, bruv! You think I'm playing? This is mine!"
Character A: "You ain't got the heart, fam. You're just a big man with no pull!"
Character B: "Say that again, I dare you! I'll show you who's washed!"
Character A: "Look at you, sweating like a pig! You need this more than me, eh?"
Character B: "I'm vexed now, bruv. You've crossed the line. This pipe... it's mine."

scenes.headline: The Setup: Pipe Dispute
scenes.supporting_text: Rain pours, adding to the grim atmosphere. Character A's eyes are wide with manic energy.
scenes.narration_text: In a grimy alley, two desperate mandem clash over the last pipe.
scenes.action_prompt: A claustrophobic, shaky close-up on Character A (yellow square sponge, big blue eyes, buck teeth, white shirt, red tie, brown shorts, anxious energetic expression) in a dimly lit, rain-slicked alleyway. He's twitching, eyes darting, skeletal fingers clutching a small, crude wooden pipe. Character B (pink starfish, round belly, worried expression, green shorts with purple flowers) looms over him, sweaty and menacing, his shadow engulfing Character A. Rain streaks down their faces. The camera is handheld, slightly out of focus, emphasizing the chaotic desperation.

scenes.headline: The Payoff: Vexed to the Max
scenes.supporting_text: Character B's final, explosive reaction. Character A's stunned defeat.
scenes.narration_text: The final insult pushes Character B over the edge, leading to a shocking snatch.
scenes.action_prompt: A rapid whip-pan to a tight close-up on Character B's (pink starfish) face. His eyes are bloodshot, a vein throbbing on his forehead. He's breathing heavily, sweat glistening. He snatches the pipe with a sudden, aggressive movement, pulling Character A (yellow square sponge) off-balance and out of frame. The camera quickly cuts back to Character A, now on the ground, looking utterly defeated and shocked, the pipe gone. A single drop of rain lands on his nose. The sound of the pipe clattering away is heard.
